content: अट् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (rarely <ab>Ā.</ab>) (अटति, आट, अटितुम्, अटित). To wander or roam about (with <ab>loc.</ab>); roam over (sometimes with <ab>acc.</ab>); भो वटो भिक्षामट <ls>Sk.</ls> go to beg alms; आट नैकटिकाश्रमान् <ls>Bk. 4. 12</ls>; महीमटन् <ls>Dk. 38</ls> --{%<ab>desid.</ab>%} अटिटिषति --{%<ab>freq.</ab>%} अटाट्यते to wander about habitually, as a religious mendicant.
